summary:
Issues Found
- crypto-trading: Equity curve froze at exactly 49205.23 for ~25h (Aug 18–19) while ETH/SOL positions were open and market was live — silent stale mark-to-market read, no error logged (filed as #50).
- coachvision, ufc-dashboard, overseer: all healthy this week — no new bugs. (coachvision's prior freeze #23 is resolved; ufc-dashboard staleness is expected due to odds_budget_exhausted, already tracked; overseer's earlier success-rate dip has not recurred.)

Top Enhancement Ideas (ranked)
1. crypto-trading — Per-asset PnL/drawdown attribution (BTC/ETH/SOL) (effort: low, impact: medium): Cheapest way to find out if 90d drawdown is one asset dragging the book or a broad strategy issue.
2. coachvision — Mobile quick-upload endpoint (PWA/iOS Shortcut) (effort: medium, impact: high): Pipeline works but has never ingested footage — this targets the actual bottleneck (capture friction), not the pipeline itself.
3. overseer — CI end-to-end dry-run of the weekly pipeline (effort: medium, impact: high): Runs all four tools + digest gen against fixtures per PR, catching integration failures unit tests miss.
4. ufc-dashboard — Correlated multi-bet (parlay) risk calculator (effort: medium, impact: medium): New analytical layer on existing odds/CLV data, not urgent but useful.

IMPLEMENTED (LAST 7 DAYS)
- overseer #26 — Track enhancement-backlog aging and surface stale (>60-day) STILL OPEN items in the weekly digest (PR #37)

timeline.text_full: I'm checking the trading bot telemetry: status is fine, last run within SLA, no errors logged, and PnL looks positive short-term but negative over 90 days, though that's just performance not a bug. I do notice a suspicious flat spot in the equity curve over a weekend where the same value repeats several times, which could mean a frozen data feed, though it's not conclusive since trading resumes normally afterward. For coachvision, it's idle but the pipeline self-test passes and frames are processing fine, with the last run only 7.5 hours ago. I'm reconsidering issue #23 about the status being frozen since 2026-08-10 — but since the last run is now fresh, that issue looks resolved and this system is healthy, just idle waiting for footage. Turning to the UFC dashboard, success rate is perfect and the last run was under an hour ago, but there's one stale event — an upcoming fight whose data hasn't updated in two weeks, likely tied to the already-tracked odds budget exhaustion issue in #76. I'm weighing whether this single stale event constitutes a new bug worth filing or if it's just a downstream symptom of the existing budget problem. Looking at Overseer, the run success rate has recovered to 1.0 after the earlier failure reported in #32, and I'm checking whether the last run age of roughly 6.8 days is within the expected weekly cadence or indicates the system is falling behind schedule. With ETH and SOL positions open, equity should move with crypto prices, so being pinned to the exact cent for 29 hours looks like frozen data rather than normal behavior, though it could just be a quiet weekend stretch. The errors array is empty and it recovered afterward, so I'm weighing whether this counts as a confirmed bug or just a borderline case worth flagging cautiously. Since no error was logged and it self-recovered, it's ambiguous enough that I'm inclined to flag it mentally but hold off on formally filing it, since the instructions stress confirmed bugs over The instructi…

timeline.text_full: I'm confirming there's no other match, then focusing on the frozen equity readings—seven identical values of 49205.23 spanning roughly 25 hours despite the bot clearly still running and logging at regular intervals, which with open ETH/SOL/BTC positions strongly suggests a genuine stuck-value bug rather than a coincidence. But I'm second-guessing whether the bot might have simply been flat (all cash) during that window, which would make constant equity a benign explanation rather than a bug—I need to check whether position state during Aug 18-19 supports this. But looking at the actual numbers, equity dropping to 49205.23 then holding exactly flat for 25 hours before resuming with different fluctuation patterns doesn't look like idle cash — it looks like a stuck cached value that got logged repeatedly without triggering any error. The surrounding small fluctuations before and after the freeze support that positions were being marked to market the whole time, making the freeze itself the anomaly worth flagging. I'm confident enough to file this as a confirmed data-integrity bug, so I'm drafting an issue titled around the frozen equity curve with the exact timestamps and duration as evidence.

timeline.text_full: I'm noticing the trading bot's performance diverges by timeframe—negative over 90 days but recovering strongly in the last 30 and 7 days—which makes me think about proposing a per-asset PnL breakdown (BTC/ETH/SOL) to pinpoint which asset is driving the recent recovery versus the longer drawdown, distinct from the circuit-breaker idea already listed. For coachvision, since it's idle and staleness alerts already exist, I'm considering a mobile quick-capture shortcut (like an iOS Shortcuts integration) that lets users instantly push post-training clips into the watch folder, which feels more specific and additive than the existing cloud-storage connector proposal, though I want to make sure it's not just a duplicate framing of the same concept. Actually simplifying to a mobile-friendly quick-upload web endpoint for on-the-spot clip capture from the gym floor - low effort, distinct from the cloud-storage connector since it's first-party lightweight upload. For the UFC dashboard, I'm considering a fighter injury/replacement webhook scraper to auto-tag replacement bouts, which draws from a different upstream data source than the closed phantom-alert issue. I like the idea of a weekly parlay/correlated-bets risk calculator using implied probabilities across the card, building nicely on the implied win probability feature already shipped. For Overseer, I'm weighing automated retry/self-heal logic for weekly review workflow failures against an end-to-end test that runs the full weekly pipeline against fixture data in CI - the latter feels like a good extension since it tests the full pipeline rather than just units. I'm ruling out the stalled weekly runs issue since that's already tracked as a bug elsewhere. Settling on four final ideas spanning different projects: PnL attribution for the trading bot, the mobile quick-upload endpoint for coachvision, the correlated-parlay risk calculator for ufc-dashboard, and I still need to pick the fourth for Overseer.
